job.description: One literal job label value, limited to 1-128 UTF-8 bytes with no control characters.

purpose: Observe the datasource's scrape samples for the selected job.
limitations: Metric meaning is declared by the installed query; backend semantics and service health are not verified.
Scrape coverage, absent series, sampling, staleness and job-label reuse can limit the observation.
Requested points do not prove returned coverage; empty results are not zero or an all-clear.
